svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Timeline of the HVAC refrigerant phase-out under the AIM Act
svg.desc: In 2020 the AIM Act became law, directing an 85 percent phasedown of HFC production by 2036. From January 1, 2025, new home AC and heat pump equipment can't be made or imported with R-410A. An EPA rule effective July 27, 2026 removed the installation deadline for pre-2025 R-410A stock, except in New York, which kept its January 1, 2026 deadline. R-410A remains available for repairs while supply tightens.
svg.text: The refrigerant phase-out, step by step
January 2025 changed what gets manufactured, not what you're allowed to use. Pre-2025 R-410A
stock can now be installed until it runs out, except in New York, which kept its January 1, 2026
deadline. New systems use R-32 or R-454B.
